method: Exact unsimplified per-date footprint and building-shadow exclusion; same 2.5 m quadrature as the heat model. Sum area × exp(-2(distance/R)^2) weights within each valid 30 m grid cell, divide by all valid weight to form p. N_eff = 1/sum(p²); top3 = sum of the three largest p values. Neither diagnostic estimates independent 100 m thermal measurements.
threshold_note: The 50% top-three share and 10,000 m² geometric area are transparent review flags, not validated accuracy thresholds and not new score exclusions. 10,000 m² equals one 100 m square in area, not one independent thermal footprint.
summary_note: Each building uses minima (cells, area, effective cells) or maxima (top-three share) over its accepted dates. Table medians are across buildings with >=3 valid dates at that extent. Paired differences compare the same observation dates, requiring >=3 paired dates.

recommended_roles.50: Exploratory local sensitivity; inspect small-area and concentration flags.
recommended_roles.100: Default screening compromise between local relevance and geometric support.
recommended_roles.150: Broader-neighbourhood sensitivity check; not intrinsically more accurate.

limits: No universal optimal radius or building-temperature accuracy can be established without finer thermal/field reference data. Spatially overlapping observations and resampled cells are correlated. Quality flags diagnose support; they do not validate the composite or energy outcomes.
